hypothesis: A coordinated affine-gap family can produce a valid scope-111 DTS by varying all seven rows coherently, escaping the row-by-row compatibility ceilings seen in sampled catalogs and local repair.
rationale: The frozen target is a packing of 105 distinct contiguous interval sums from seven five-gap vectors. Parameterizing each gap as c[j]+row*t[j] couples the rows through a low-dimensional algebraic structure while preserving exact integer arithmetic, positivity, and scope checks. Algebraic/structured DTS families are a documented alternative to general heuristic search, and this family has not been tested in the repository.
expected_information_gain: Tests whether a low-dimensional affine relation across row gaps can support near-perfect difference packing, distinguishing a promising structured basin from the previously sampled unstructured compatibility space.
method: For row index r=0..6, construct marks by cumulative sums of five gaps g[j,r]=c[j]+r*t[j]. Use deterministic simulated annealing over the ten integer parameters c and t, with random feasible restarts, exact unique-difference count as the primary objective, and penalties for nonpositive gaps, scope overflow, and within-row collisions. Run seeds 20260903, 20260904, and 20260905 for 40 seconds each at limit 111. Independently validate the best seven rows with the repository integer verifier.
metric: best exact unique-difference count, local collision count, scope, parameter vectors, target assignment, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A validator-valid seven-row assignment with scope<=111 is exactly a true-objective witness; affine-family score and partial unique counts are proxy diagnostics only.

configuration.annealing: single/two-parameter integer mutations with 3 percent feasible restarts

kill_condition: Stop at the first independently validated scope-111 witness or after all three 40-second seed budgets; preserve the best exact state and do not infer global infeasibility from family failure.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if complete and validator-valid

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new coordinated algebraic family rather than row-mask sampling

interpretation: All three feasible affine-gap annealing runs completed without a target witness. The best state had 89 unique differences and failed the independent verifier due to 13 duplicate differences.
what_was_learned: Coherent affine row coupling is too restrictive under the tested ten-parameter family: the best feasible state remained at 89/105 unique differences, well below the prior 97--100 coordinate/library proxies. Further affine seed or temperature tuning is low-value.
recommended_next_action: Close the affine-gap family and test a materially different structured construction or return to WAITING_FOR_CAPABILITY.
repetition_justification: This is a new representation and hypothesis family. The ten parameters impose a coherent row-index relation absent from prior coordinate annealing, random catalogs, exact-cover pools, and the public mark-by-mark reference.
